capabilities: Browse folder levels in side-by-side columns
Filter items by typing, including pinyin
Show folder notes and property-based display names
Group items by a frontmatter property
Create daily notes from a calendar with path templates
disambiguation: Not a multi-column note layout; the columns are folder levels inside a file browser.
extras: Online holiday data updates are opt-in and must be triggered manually; Templater templates can run user scripts, so only trusted templates should be used. Settings are searchable in Obsidian's settings search.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer reveals one folder level at a time, so moving through deep folder trees loses context and requires repeated expanding.

relations.evidence: Markdown supports Obsidian core Templates variables or native Templater creation
Choose Simple grid, Colorful or Journal in Settings → Appearance → Theme, with Style Settings support

summary: Finder-style multi-column folder and file navigator with type-to-filter (including pinyin), folder notes, property groups and a calendar for daily notes.
